title: This Contract Is Toast — output and shutdown
shortTitle: This Contract Is Toast — output and shutdown
summary: An output arrangement for breadcrumbs raises the question whether the producer may stop production after losses.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

What is the output commitment? How should good faith, commercial reasons for shutting down, and the effect on the buyer be considered? The problem points to Feld v. Henry S. Levy & Sons. The reference supplies a line of inquiry, not an automatically imported holding.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
